title: derby01: mod kits
description: The cars: every car is the same model, built up with a mod kit. A kit sets how the car drives (small, fair differences: what it does better it pays for somewhere else) and which add-on parts it wears. Each part sits in a damage zone and flies off when that side has taken enough of a beating; all of them go when the car is wrecked.

defaults.description: The kit each car starts with on a new setup, car 1 first; with more cars than kits listed, the list starts again. Players change it on the setup screen.

kits.description: The kits, in the order the setup screen lists them. There must be one with the id 'stock': a car whose kit is unknown drives as stock.

id.description: The kit's id. The screens send it in the setup and the round, so keep it once players have picked it.

name.description: Shown on the setup screen, in capitals.

blurb.description: One sentence for the setup screen (the kit's tooltip): what this car is good at, and what it pays for it.

handling.description: How this car drives, as factors on the stock car.

exhausts.description: Where the nitro flame comes out, if not from the car's own two exhausts under the back bumper (the muscle car's side pipes, say).

items.description: An exhaust's outlet on the car.

parts.description: The add-on parts. At most 24: the screens send which are still on as 24 bits.

grip.description: Sideways grip of the tyres (1 = stock). Less grip slides wider in the corners.

steer.description: How sharply it turns in (1 = stock).

vmax.description: Top speed (1 = stock, about 104 km/h without nitro).

slide.description: How easily the tail steps out under power, and how loose it is on the handbrake: 0 stays planted, 0.65 is the drift car.

grass.description: Grip and drag on grass, where tarmac is 1: 0.78 is stock, the rally car minds it least.

tough.description: How well it takes a hit: damage to the chassis is divided by this.

mass.description: Weight, as a factor on the car's mass: heavier wins the shoving and turns slower.

nitro.description: The nitro bottle: its kick, its top speed, how long it lasts and how hard the car tugs at the wheel on it.

zone.description: Which hits wear it down: front, rear, lf/rf/lr/rr (left/right, front/rear quarter), left or right (either quarter on that side), or top (a share of every hit).

hp.description: How much damage on its zone it takes before it flies off. Paintballs count a third.

at.description: Where the part sits on the car.

shapes.description: What it is made of: shapes from the kit-parts package, each in a material.

shape.description: A shape from the kit-parts package (assets/assets.json has each one's size).

material.description: A material from the kit-parts package, or 'team' for the car's team colour.

at.description: Where the shape sits, from the part's position. Default [0, 0, 0].
